To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the potential environmental benefits of recycling are highly dependent on the cell chemistry of the battery, and that the environmental impact of the recycling process needs to be adapted to each cell chemistry, in order to achieve maximum benefits.

recycling can reduce the environmental impacts of battery manufacturing, especially when the recycling process is optimized for the cell chemistry, but that the potential environmental benefit depends on the cell chemistry and can be even negative for certain cells.

recycling can reduce the impact of battery production, that this impact reduction depends on the cell chemistry and that the process needs to be adapted to each cell chemistry in order to obtain maximum benefit.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a life cycle assessment framework that is able to account for the specific cell chemistry and its impact on recycling processes, which is essential for the evaluation of the environmental impacts of future battery recycling.
providing an important step toward a cell chemistry specific life cycle assessment of lithium ion battery recycling.

a first step toward the development of a cell chemistry specific life cycle assessment methodology for the recycling of lithium ion batteries, which can be used to evaluate the recycling of different battery chemistries and to optimize the recycling processes for maximum benefit.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

recycling of lithium ion batteries can reduce the potential environmental impact of battery production significantly, but that this reduction is dependent on the cell chemistry and on the recycling process used.
, for all cell chemistries investigated, recycling can be beneficial, but the extent to which this is the case, depends on the specific process and the cell chemistry.
, for the environmental impact assessment of lithium ion battery production, recycling should not be disregarded.

recycling is an essential step to achieve the environmental benefits of batteries.
recycling of lithium ion batteries can be a significant contribution toward a sustainable circular economy.
, to obtain a maximum benefit from battery recycling, it is important to take into account the specific cell chemistry of the battery to be recycled.

the cell chemistry specific design of recycling processes is a key factor for their environmental performance.
